name: Clinical Syncopated Modular
description: Precise, clinical, and syncopated modern techno inspired by Temudo, Cravo, and Kwartz. Focuses on dry punchy transients, tight pocket grooves, modular bleep variations, and unexpected rhythmic mutes.

philosophy: Transients are king: In clinical techno, sounds are extremely dry and punchy. Avoid muddy reverb washes; use short room acoustics instead.
The power of silence: Strategic 1-beat or 2-beat sudden mutes create more impact than a 32-bar white noise riser.
Syncopation and displacement: Shifting a hi-hat or bleep by 1/32nd note creates an unexpected addictive pocket bounce.
Modular dialogue: Two short synth motifs that converse with each other in call-and-response.

sound_design.Tight Boxy Kick: A shorter, punchier kick drum with prominent 80-120Hz chest punch rather than loose sub boom. Short decay envelope (180ms).
sound_design.Clinical Bass Stab: Mono sawtooth synth with zero attack, 90ms decay, 0% sustain. Live 12 Saturator in Analog Clip mode for bite.
sound_design.Modular Call & Response: Two synth instances: Synth A plays on beats 1.2 and 2.4; Synth B responds on offbeats with pitch modulation.
sound_design.Dry Shaker / Rim Pattern: Ultra-short 808 rimshot or 606 hi-hat with Live 12 Drum Buss (Transient control boosted +2.5 dB).

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Design Dry Transients & Drum Buss
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Dial in kick and tight bass stab at 137 BPM. Apply Drum Buss to glue them together with crisp transient punch.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Program the Syncopated Percussion Pocket
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Add short rimshots, dry shakers, and syncopated closed hats. Use groove displacement on the offbeat 16ths.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Construct Call-and-Response Modular Hooks
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Program two modular bleep channels that converse back and forth across 2 bars. Keep them short, percussive, and punchy.

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Arrange with Sharp Surgical Mutes
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Follow the generated locators: DJ Intro (32 bars), Pocket Build (32 bars), Clinical Peak 1 (48 bars), Sudden Mute / Tension (16 bars), Peak 2 (64 bars), Outro (32 bars).

step_by_step_walkthrough.title: Mixdown & Dynamic Precision
step_by_step_walkthrough.detail: Ensure high dynamic contrast. Use surgical EQ cuts to keep the 200-500Hz range sparkling clean.

tracks.name: Tight Kick
tracks.annotation: Punchy, dry, short decay 909/808 hybrid. Strong punch at 90Hz.

tracks.name: Clinical Bass
tracks.annotation: Tight syncopated bass stab. Zero sustain, fast decay.

tracks.name: Dry Closed Hat
tracks.annotation: Extremely short decay hat with syncopated 16th velocity.

tracks.name: Syncopated Rim
tracks.annotation: Acoustic/electronic rimshot hitting on syncopated pocket beats.

tracks.name: Modular Synth A
tracks.annotation: Main clinical bleep sequence (Call). Fast FM modulation.

tracks.name: Modular Synth B
tracks.annotation: Secondary syncopated response synth. Contrasting pitch/timbre.

tracks.name: Subtle Noise Wash
tracks.annotation: Short room reverb bursts and subtle noise gates for atmosphere.

tracks.name: Transition Mutes
tracks.annotation: Stutter edits, tape stops, and sharp transitional impacts.

sections.name: Clinical DJ Intro (32 bars)
sections.description: Tight kick, syncopated rim, and subtle bass pulse for instant mixing.

sections.name: Pocket Incline (32 bars)
sections.description: Modular Synth A enters; percussion velocity builds with micro-swing.

sections.name: Clinical Peak 1 (48 bars)
sections.description: Both Modular Synth A & B engage in rapid call-and-response. Pure dancefloor momentum.

sections.name: Surgical Tension Breather (16 bars)
sections.description: Sudden kick drop. Dry modular conversation continues in isolated space with sudden stutter edits.

sections.name: Full Clinical Climax (64 bars)
sections.description: Kick and bass return with full authority. All elements active with maximum groove precision.

sections.name: DJ Outro (32 bars)
sections.description: Synths step back; rhythmic skeleton remains for clean DJ transition out.
